I have worked this quarter-hectare since I was a young man, and my father taught me that beans fix their own strength into the soil, so buying a whole bag of chemical fertilizer for this small piece is wasting money I do not have. I will spread manure from my animals on it before the rains come, and I will sow the seed I kept from last harvest with my own hands. My wife and I will weed it twice and pick the pods ourselves when they are ready, so I will not pay for outside workers.
